faq_heading: Pebble Hill houses: your questions answered

faq.q: What did houses in Pebble Hill sell for?
faq.a: 42 houses sold in Pebble Hill between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,429,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Pebble Hill?
faq.a: The median was 16 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.9% of the last list price (7% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Pebble Hill sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 42 houses that sold in Pebble Hill went for between $1,257,500 and $1,676,750, around a median of $1,429,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Pebble Hill sell above asking price?
faq.a: 7% of the 42 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.9% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Pebble Hill?
faq.a: The median year built was 1975 for the 42 houses sold in Pebble Hill.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Pebble Hill usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Pebble Hill had 4 bedrooms, from the 42 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

blocks.text: Pebble Hill houses for sale now
What Pebble Hill houses sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

42 houses sold in Pebble Hill with a median price of $1,429,000 (the middle half sold between $1,257,500 and $1,676,750), taking a median of 16 days to sell at 96.9% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $580 per square foot, a median year built of 1975 and a median lot of 8,628 square feet.

blocks.text: How Pebble Hill compares with the rest of Tsawwassen

The median house in Pebble Hill sold for $1,429,000, 5% below the Tsawwassen median of $1,499,500 across 158 sales. Pebble Hill houses took a median 16 days to sell, against 20 days for Tsawwassen as a whole.
